Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Use a Reaction to give a nearby ally 1 Boon against a physical attack. Afterward, it may move up to 2 squares to your side without provoking.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One visible willing ally within 2 squares, before it defends against a physical attack.
Type
Magic / Defense / Movement

The ally gains 1 Boon to the defense. After the attack resolves, it may move up to 2 squares without provoking to a free square adjacent to you.
